entries.title: The crew no longer asks you a question you already answered
entries.body: When you answer a question on a card, a crewmate or reviewer that comes back to it reads your answer and acts on it instead of raising a second card. A question is asked again only when its facts changed, and then the card opens with your earlier answer.
entries.noPicture: This changes which cards reach the screen, not how any card or view looks.
